mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance becomes increasingly accommodative.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months (3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) in more than 30% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction between UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts signal sustained economic momentum that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, rising HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months indicates labor market strength that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE has declined over the prior 3 months (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1300 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals weakening residential construction that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) in more than 30% of instances where HOUST has been below 1300 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and contraction in real personal consumption expenditures signals supply chain disruption and reduced consumer demand, depressing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The interaction between INDPRO decline and RSAFS contraction fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate of at least 0.25% within the last month signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >= 0.25% in the last month
failure_condition: In the high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS has increased by at least 0.25% in the last month.
